tours.title: 10 Days Kenya Honeymoon Safari Adventure
tours.excerpt: Our 10 Days Best Kenya Safari Adventures takes you for a long safari tour in some of the most wild parks Kenya has to over with beautiful scenery. Amboseli National Park which is the oldest and the second in popularity a
overview: Our 10 Days Best Kenya Safari Adventures takes you for a long safari tour in some of the most wild parks Kenya has to over with beautiful scenery. Amboseli National Park which is the oldest and the second in popularity after the legendary Masai Mara Game Reserve.

The park not only offers great game viewing but is also the place to go for the best views of iconic Mount Kilimanjaro, Africa most tallest mountain. Amboseli National Park is situated in Loitoktok District, Rift Valley Province of Kenya.

Amboseli National Park ecosystem is mainly savannah grassland spread across the Kenya -Tanzania border, an area of low scrubby vegetation and open grassy plains, all of which makes for easy game viewing. It is the best place in Africa to get close to free-ranging elephants, which are for sure a breath-taking sight to behold.

itinerary.title: Day 1: Arrival in Nairobi
itinerary.body: Arrive at Jomo Kenyatta International Airport where you’ll be warmly welcomed by our safari representative. Enjoy a private transfer to your hotel for check-in and relaxation after your journey. Depending on your arrival time, you may have a romantic dinner at a fine restaurant in Nairobi. Overnight: Nairobi Serena Hotel or similar Meal Plan: Bed & Breakfast

itinerary.title: Day 2: Nairobi – Amboseli National Park
itinerary.body: After breakfast, depart for Amboseli National Park, driving through scenic landscapes to the foot of Mount Kilimanjaro. Arrive at your lodge in time for lunch, then enjoy an afternoon game drive in the park, famous for its large elephant herds and breathtaking views of Kilimanjaro. Overnight: Amboseli Serena Safari Lodge or Oltukai Lodge Meal Plan: Full Board

itinerary.title: Day 3: Full Day in Amboseli National Park
itinerary.body: Spend the day exploring Amboseli on morning and afternoon game drives with chances to spot lions, cheetahs, giraffes, and plenty of elephants. Visit a Maasai village for a cultural experience and enjoy a romantic sundowner at Observation Hill overlooking the plains. Overnight: Amboseli Serena Safari Lodge or Oltukai Lodge Meal Plan: Full Board

itinerary.title: Day 4: Amboseli – Sweetwaters Game Reserve (Ol Pejeta Conservancy)
itinerary.body: After breakfast, depart for Sweetwaters Game Reserve via Nairobi and proceed to Nanyuki at the foothills of Mount Kenya. Arrive in time for lunch at your tented camp. Later, enjoy an afternoon game drive in the reserve with chances to see the Big Five and visit the Chimpanzee Sanctuary. Overnight: Sweetwaters Serena Camp (Ol Pejeta) Meal Plan: Full Board

itinerary.title: Day 5: Sweetwaters Game Reserve
itinerary.body: Spend the day exploring the conservancy. Visit the endangered rhino sanctuary and enjoy intimate moments watching wildlife up close. You may also choose an optional horseback or night game drive for a more exclusive experience. Overnight: Sweetwaters Serena Camp Meal Plan: Full Board

itinerary.title: Day 6: Sweetwaters – Lake Nakuru National Park
itinerary.body: Depart after breakfast for Lake Nakuru National Park, descending into the Great Rift Valley. Arrive at your lodge for lunch, then head out for an afternoon game drive around the lake to see flamingos, rhinos, lions, and leopards. Overnight: Sarova Lion Hill Game Lodge or Lake Nakuru Lodge Meal Plan: Full Board

itinerary.title: Day 10: Masai Mara – Nairobi / Departure
itinerary.body: Enjoy an early morning game drive before breakfast. Return to Nairobi with scenic stops along the way and be dropped off at Jomo Kenyatta International Airport for your onward flight. Meal Plan: Breakfast & Lunch

itinerary.title: Day 7: Lake Nakuru – Lake Naivasha
itinerary.body: After breakfast, enjoy a short game drive as you leave Nakuru and continue to Lake Naivasha, arriving by midday. In the afternoon, take a relaxing boat ride on the lake to see hippos and abundant birdlife, followed by a visit to Crescent Island for a guided walking safari among zebras and giraffes. Overnight: Lake Naivasha Sopa Resort or Enashipai Resort & Spa Meal Plan: Full Board

itinerary.title: Day 8: Lake Naivasha – Masai Mara Game Reserve
itinerary.body: Depart for the world-famous Masai Mara Game Reserve after breakfast. Arrive in time for lunch at your lodge or camp, then set out on an afternoon game drive to spot the Big Five and enjoy your first glimpse of the vast Mara plains. Overnight: Mara Serena Safari Lodge or Tipilikwani Mara Camp Meal Plan: Full Board

itinerary.title: Day 9: Full Day in Masai Mara
itinerary.body: Begin your day with an optional early morning balloon safari, followed by a champagne breakfast in the wild. Spend the rest of the day exploring the Mara on game drives, spotting wildlife such as lions, elephants, wildebeests, and cheetahs. In the evening, enjoy a romantic bush dinner under the stars. Overnight: Mara Serena Safari Lodge or Tipilikwani Mara Camp Meal Plan: Full Board

tours.title: 10 Days Kenya & Tanzania Amazing Wildlife Safari
tours.excerpt: Our 10 Days Masai Mara, Lake Naivasha, Amboseli , Lake Manyara, Serengeti, Ngorongoro Crater, Tarangire Safari takes you to the most famous game parks in Africa. Masai Mara Game Reserve which is the most popular tourism
overview: Our 10 Days Masai Mara, Lake Naivasha, Amboseli , Lake Manyara, Serengeti, Ngorongoro Crater, Tarangire Safari takes you to the most famous game parks in Africa. Masai Mara Game Reserve which is the most popular tourism destination in Kenya. Located in the Great Rift Valley in primarily open grassland. Wildlife is most concentrated on the reserve’s western escarpment. Its regarded as the jewel of Kenya’s wildlife Viewing areas. The annual wildebeest’s migration alone involves over 1.5 million animals arriving in July and departing in November. Hardly can a visitor miss to spot the big five. The phenomenal wildbeeste migration which is a spectacular event only seen in Masai mara is the wonder of the world.

Lake Naivasha is the largest freshwater lake fringed by lush forests of fever trees and overlooked by the ragged-edged of the volcanic Mount Longonot on floor of the Great Rift Valley. It is home to about 400 species of birds and wildlife such as Giraffe, hippo and waterbuck, but the main attraction is the bird life, which is best observed on a boat trip on the lake..

Amboseli National Park is situated in Loitoktok District, Rift Valley Province of Kenya. Amboseli National Park ecosystem is mainly savannah grassland spread across the Kenya -Tanzania border, an area of low scrubby vegetation and open grassy plains, all of which makes for easy game viewing. It is the best place in Africa to get close to free-ranging elephants, which are for sure a breath-taking sight to behold, whereas various African lions, buffaloes, giraffes, zebras and other species can also be spotted, offering spectacular photographic experiences.

itinerary.title: Day 1: Nairobi – Masai Mara Game Reserve
itinerary.body: Pick up from your hotel at 7:30am, and head for Masai Mara Game Reserve. Just a few kilometers from Nairobi you’ll be able to have a view of the great rift valley, where you will have a breathtaking view of the floor of the rift valley. Later continue driving through Longonot and Suswa and on to the Western walls before arriving in time for lunch. After lunch and relaxation proceed for an afternoon game drive in the reserve where you will be on the look for the big five; Elephants, Lions, Buffalo, Leopards and Rhino. Dinner and Overnight at the Mara Sopa Lodge or a similar lodge.

itinerary.title: Day 2: Full Day Masai Mara Game Reserve
itinerary.body: Early morning game drive and return for breakfast. After breakfast spend the entire day viewing the great predators and explore the parks amazingly high concentration of wild animals. On the plains are enormous herds of grazing animals plus the elusive Cheetah and leopard hiding amidst acacia boughs. You will have picnic lunches in the Reserve as you scale the Mara beauty seated at the banks of Mara river. During the stay you will also have an optional opportunity to visit a village of the Maasai people to witness the singing and dancing that are part of their daily lives and sacred rituals. A glimpse into their homes and social structure is a poignant experience. Dinner and Overnight at the Mara Sopa Lodge or a similar lodge.

itinerary.title: Day 3: Masai Mara Game Reserve – Lake Naivasha
itinerary.body: Take pre breakfast then game drives then return to the camp for breakfast ,exit the park and drive to Lake Naivasha.There will be a stop to view the great rift valley scenery as you proceed to Naivasha you will arrive time for lunch, Check in at Sopa Lodge Naivasha and have lunch, Later in the afternoon game drive with a visit to Hells Gate National Park which allows Hiking, Bicycling, Rock climbing and photography of wildlife and a visit to geothermal power plant. Later dinner and overnight at Sopa Lodge Naivasha or a similar lodge.

itinerary.title: Day 4: Lake Naivasha – Amboseli National Park
itinerary.body: Take a morning boat ride then drive to Amboseli national park with packed lunches. Arriving with game drive proceeding to your lodge Oltukai lodge. Check in to your lodge, have lunch and a short rest. Afternoon game drive at the park later Dinner and overnight at Oltukai lodge or a similar lodge.

itinerary.title: Day 5: Amboseli National Park – Lake Manyara National Park
itinerary.body: Pre-morning game viewing, and drive to the Namanga Border, where you will be met by your Tanzania guide who will drive you to Lake Manyara. We arrive at our Lake Manyara camp in time for lunch. Later, we head into the park for game viewing. This soda ash lake consists of huge flocks of pink flamingos, giving a breathtaking scenery. The park is also famously known for its tree-climbing lions, big number of elephants, giraffes, zebras, waterbucks, warthogs, baboons and the lesser known wildlife like the dik-diks, and the klipspringer. Dinner and overnight will be in basic tents at the Panorama Campsite or Similar.

itinerary.title: Day 6: Lake Manyara National Park – Serengeti National Park
itinerary.body: After our breakfast, we head to Serengeti via the Ol Duvai Gorge Museum, where the early man appeared, a million years ago. Upon arrival, we will head to the Serengeti National Park, which is widely known for the greatest wildlife spectacle, the great migration of wildebeest. The Plains are also home to resident population of elephants, cheetahs, lions, giraffes and birds. overnight at Serengeti Serena Safari Lodge or Serengeti Tortilis Camp or a similar lodge / camp.

itinerary.title: Day 7: Full Day Serengeti National Park
itinerary.body: Morning and afternoon game drive in the Serengeti with a lunch and leisure break at the lodge or campsite in the mid afternoon .The term ‘serengeti’ means endless plains in maasai language. In the central plains there are carnivores like, leopards, hyena and cheetah. This park is normally the scene of the annual migration of the wildebeest and zebras, which occurs between Serengeti and kenya’s maasai mara game reserve. Eagles, Flamingos, duck, geese, vultures are among the birds that can be seen in the park, dinner and overnight at Serengeti Serena Safari Lodge or Serengeti Tortilis Camp or a similar lodge / camp.

itinerary.title: Day 8: Serengeti National Park – Ngorongoro Crater
itinerary.body: After breakfast, Drive to Ngorongoro Crater for game drives. This is the best place in Tanzania to see black rhino as well as prides of lion that include the magnificent black-manned males. There are lots of colorful flamingos and a variety of water birds. Other game that you can see includes leopard, cheetah, hyena, other members of the antelope family, and small mammals. In the late afternoon. Drive to SIMBA Campsite or Neptune Ngorongoro Luxury Lodge, or a similar lodge / camp for overnight.

itinerary.title: Day 9: Ngorongoro Crater – Tarangire National Park
itinerary.body: After breakfast depart for Tarangire National park, Tanzania’s third largest national park and sanctuary for an unusually large elephant population. Majestic baobab trees are an interesting feature of the park, dwarfing the animals that feed beneath them. Animals concentrate along the Tarangire River, which provides the only permanent water supply in the area. There is a great diversity of wildlife including lion, leopard, cheetah and up to six thousand elephant. Arrive in time for lunch after lunch, afternoon spent game viewing in the park, dinner and overnight at the Tarangire safari lodge or Nimali tarangire camp or a similar camp / lodge.

itinerary.title: Day 10: Tarangire National Park – Arusha
itinerary.body: Early morning game drive later return to your lodge for Breakfast. After breakfast check out with a short game drive en-route off Tarangire National Park and drive to Arusha, drop off at your respective hotel or Airport.

tours.title: 10 Days Kenya Wildlife Adventure Safari
tours.excerpt: Our 10 Days Kenya Safari Adventure takes you to seven of Kenya’s top safari destinations to give you the complete overview of this fascinating country. Each of these seven parks offers something unique: whether it’s ende
overview: Our 10 Days Kenya Safari Adventure takes you to seven of Kenya’s top safari destinations to give you the complete overview of this fascinating country. Each of these seven parks offers something unique: whether it’s endemic wildlife not seen elsewhere, dramatic landscapes, or sheer animal variety. It’s the ultimate Kenyan safari package for those wanting to maximise their game-viewing opportunities. Amboseli National Park is situated in Loitoktok District, Rift Valley Province of Kenya. Amboseli National Park ecosystem is mainly savannah grassland spread across the Kenya -Tanzania border, an area of low scrubby vegetation and open grassy plains, all of which makes for easy game viewing. It is the best place in Africa to get close to free-ranging elephants, which are for sure a breath-taking sight to behold, whereas various African lions, buffaloes, giraffes, zebras and other species can also be spotted, offering spectacular photographic experiences.

Sweetwaters Game Reserve & Chimp Sanctuary . This 24000 acre private reserve saddling the Equator enjoys magnificent views across the plains to the snow-capped peaks of Mount Kenya, and has an abundance of wildlife and tropical vegetation. Sweetwaters Game Reserve and Chimpanzee Sanctuary is the closest reserve to Kenya’s Capital Nairobi to boast all of the “Big 5” game – Lion, Leopard, Rhino, Elephant and Buffalo. Samburu National Reserve is a Kenyan Safari that combines great landscape views, superb wildlife spotting and rich African culture.

Samburu National Reserve lies on the fringes of the vast and arid desert once known as the Northern Frontier District, whose heat-scorched scrublands extend all the way to the jade-green waters of Lake Turkana and beyond. Samburu’s diverse fauna includes rare Grevy’s Zebra, Beisa Oryx, Reticulated Giraffe, Somali Ostrich, Elephant, Lion, and Cheetah. This sanctuary awaits you with 350 bird species including the sharp Kingfisher, Sunbird, Bee-eater, Marabou Stork, Bateleur and Palm-nut Vulture.

itinerary.title: Day 1: Nairobi – Amboseli National Park
itinerary.body: Depart Nairobi Hotel early morning by scheduled road to the Amboseli National Park. On arrival with game drive en-route to OlTukai lodge for check-in followed by lunch at the lodge. Set After lunch game drive until sunset in the expansive Amboseli plains which are home to herds of elephants that feed on the large acacia trees. Have a Barbecue Dinner set under a canopy of trees on the banks of Enkong Narok swamp with a spectacular view of game. Diner and overnight at the Lodge or a similar lodge.

itinerary.title: Day 2: Full Day Amboseli National Park
itinerary.body: Early morning game drive later return back to lodge for breakfast. After breakfast Full day spend in the park with packed lunch in search of its popular residents like the well known predators and their opponents like the Zebra, Wildebeest, Giraffe, Hippo with a view of Mt Kilimanjaro .Later return to your camp for dinner and overnight at OlTukai lodge or a similar lodge.

itinerary.title: Day 3: Amboseli National Park – Sweetwaters National Reserve
itinerary.body: Early Morning breakfast. check out and head on to Sweetwaters National Reserve, towards Nanyuki, just 30 kms from the turn off to Nanyuki town. En-route we cross the equator, which is very close to the second highest mountain in Africa, the snow capped Mount Kenya. Sweetwaters Tented Camp is located on a private game ranch and set on a 22,000-acre rhino and chimpanzee sanctuary on Ol Pejeta Ranch. Lunch at Sweetwaters Tented Camp. A late afternoon game drive where you may be able to see a variety of animals like rhino, buffalo, giraffe, and zebra and plains game. Dinner and overnight at Sweetwaters Tented Camp.

itinerary.title: Day 4: Sweetwaters National Reserve – Samburu National Reserve
itinerary.body: Early Morning breakfast. check out and head on to Samburu National Reserve, arriving in time for lunch. After lunch proceed for an afternoon game drive with a chance to see Samburu’s ‘Special Five’- the Reticulated giraffe, the Grevy’s Zebra Gerenuk, Beisa Oryx and Somali Ostrich among other big game like elephant and lion. Dinner and overnight at the Samburu Sopa Lodge or a similar lodge.

itinerary.title: Day 5: Full Day Samburu National Reserve
itinerary.body: After breakfast, head out for a full day of game viewing drive in this dry semi-arid park with its striking background view of the Mathew’s Range. The surrounding terrain is renowned for rare game, -long necked gerenuk, Grevy’s zebra, reticulated giraffe, and the Beisa Oryx. Leopard is the frequent passer-by. Drive through the gently flowing Uaso Nyiro river which traverses this Park provides evergreen vegetation for the wildlife found in this park. Game drives and bird watching safaris are the ideal way to experience the native wildlife in its natural splendor. Dinner and overnight at the Samburu Sopa Lodge or a similar lodge.

itinerary.title: Day 6: Samburu National Reserve – Lake Nakuru National Park
itinerary.body: After breakfast depart Samburu National Reserve for Lake Nakuru National Park in the Great Rift Valley passing through the arid lands and the highlands of Kenya. After lunch go for an exciting game drive until 6.30 in the evening. The bird life here is world renown and over 400 birds’s species exist here, White Pelicans, Plovers, Egrets and Marabou Stork. It is also one of the very few places in Africa to see the White and Black Rhino and rare Rothschild Giraffe. Dinner and overnight at Flamingo Hill Camp or a similar camp.

itinerary.title: Day 7: Lake Nakuru National Park – Lake Bogoria – Lake Naivasha
itinerary.body: Early morning breakfast leave lake Nakuru with a short game drive with packed lunch and proceed to Lake Bogoria A 3 hours drive to main gate bogoria. but you will have a stop at the Equator line few metres away from the equator line towards the northern side; the water spins clockwise. Towards the southern; spins anticlockwise just Amazing. later proceed to bogoria which is a shallow soda lake with a beautiful scenery and home of lot of flamingo’s and hot springs the geysers. After lunch drive back to Lake Naivasha A 3 and half hours drive to Naivasha for Dinner and overnight at Lake Naivasha Sopa Lodge or Crater Tented Camp.

itinerary.title: Day 8: Lake Naivasha – Masai Mara Game Reserve
itinerary.body: Early morning breakfast. After breakfast leave Lake Naivasha for Masai Mara A 5 hours drive to main gate you will pass to Narok town which is famous Masai town proceeding to Masai Mara park. You will arrive in time for lunch Check in at Mara or Fig Tree Mara Camp and have lunch. Afternoon game drive through the park in search of the Lion, Cheetah, Elephant, Buffalo and other members of the Big five plus other animals. Dinner and overnight at Ashnil Mara camp or Mara Bush Camp / Base Camp.

itinerary.title: Day 9: Full Day Masai Mara Game Reserve
itinerary.body: Early morning game drive and return to camp for breakfast. After breakfast Full day in the park with packed lunch in search of its popular residents, The Masai Mara plains are full of wildebeest during migration season early July to end of September, zebra, impala, topi, giraffe, Thomson’s gazelle are regularly seen, leopards, lions, hyenas, cheetah, jackal and bat-eared foxes. Black rhino are a little shy and hard to spot but are often seen at a distance if you are lucky. Hippos are abundant in the Mara River as are very large Nile crocodiles, who lay in wait for a meal as the wildebeest cross on their annual quest to find new pastures. later Meals and overnight at the Camp / Lodge.

itinerary.title: Day 10: Masai Mara Game Reserve – Nairobi
itinerary.body: Early morning game drive later return to your lodge for Breakfast. After breakfast check out with a short game drive en-route off Masai Mara Game Reserve and drive to Nairobi. you will arrive Nairobi in time for lunch. Lunch at carnivore afterwards drop off at your respective hotel or Airport.

tours.title: 12 Days Best of Kenya & Tanzania Wildlife Safari
tours.excerpt: Embark on an unforgettable wildlife adventure through the breathtaking landscapes of Kenya and Tanzania, experiencing some of the most renowned national parks and game reserves in East Africa. This safari offers an incre
overview: Embark on an unforgettable wildlife adventure through the breathtaking landscapes of Kenya and Tanzania, experiencing some of the most renowned national parks and game reserves in East Africa. This safari offers an incredible opportunity to witness the famous Big Five, diverse ecosystems, and the awe-inspiring Great Migration in action.

The journey begins in Nairobi, Kenya’s bustling capital, before heading into the vast plains of the Maasai Mara National Reserve . Known for its incredible wildlife density, Maasai Mara is home to lions, elephants, leopards, rhinos, and buffalos, along with thousands of wildebeests and zebras that migrate across its golden savannahs. The reserve also offers a chance to interact with the Maasai people and learn about their rich culture and traditions.

From the Maasai Mara, the adventure continues to Lake Nakuru National Park , a sanctuary for rhinos and a paradise for bird lovers, with its famous pink flamingos gracing the lake’s shores. The journey then proceeds to Amboseli National Park , where herds of elephants roam freely against the stunning backdrop of Mount Kilimanjaro. The park is also home to a variety of wildlife, including cheetahs, giraffes, and an abundance of bird species.

itinerary.title: Day 1: Arrival in Nairobi, Kenya
itinerary.body: Your safari begins with your arrival at Jomo Kenyatta International Airport in Nairobi, where you’ll be met by your safari guide and transferred to your hotel for rest and a briefing. You can enjoy an optional visit to the Giraffe Centre or David Sheldrick Elephant Orphanage. Spend the night at Nairobi Serena Hotel, Giraffe Manor, or Eka Hotel.

itinerary.title: Day 2: Nairobi to Maasai Mara National Reserve
itinerary.body: After breakfast, depart for Maasai Mara, a 5-6 hour drive, with a stop at the Great Rift Valley viewpoint along the way. Arrive in time for lunch at your lodge, followed by an afternoon game drive in search of the Big Five. Overnight at Mara Serena Lodge, Ashnil Mara Camp, or Sarova Mara Camp.

itinerary.title: Day 3: Full Day in Maasai Mara
itinerary.body: Start your day with an early morning game drive to catch predators in action, and consider an optional hot air balloon safari at sunrise. Later, visit a Maasai village to experience their culture, and enjoy afternoon and evening game drives. Overnight at Mara Serena Lodge, Ashnil Mara Camp, or Sarova Mara Camp.

itinerary.title: Day 4: Maasai Mara to Serengeti National Park (Tanzania)
itinerary.body: After breakfast, depart for Serengeti National Park via the Isebania border. Complete immigration formalities and switch vehicles/guides before driving into Serengeti with game viewing en route. Overnight at Serengeti Serena Lodge, Melia Serengeti Lodge, or Kubu Kubu Tented Lodge.

itinerary.title: Day 5: Full Day in Serengeti
itinerary.body: Spend the day exploring the vast Serengeti plains with early morning and afternoon game drives. Look out for the Great Migration (seasonal) and spot lions, cheetahs, leopards, elephants, and more. Overnight at Serengeti Serena Lodge, Melia Serengeti Lodge, or Kubu Kubu Tented Lodge.

itinerary.title: Day 6: Serengeti to Ngorongoro Conservation Area
itinerary.body: Begin with an early morning game drive before driving to Ngorongoro, with an optional stop at Olduvai Gorge, a historical site. Spend the evening relaxing at your lodge overlooking the crater. Overnight at Ngorongoro Serena Lodge, Neptune Ngorongoro Lodge, or Ngorongoro Wildlife Lodge.

itinerary.title: Day 7: Ngorongoro Crater Tour
itinerary.body: Descend into the Ngorongoro Crater for a full-day safari, exploring the world’s largest intact volcanic caldera, home to the Big Five. Enjoy a picnic lunch inside the crater before returning to your lodge in the evening. Overnight at Ngorongoro Serena Lodge, Neptune Ngorongoro Lodge, or Ngorongoro Wildlife Lodge.

itinerary.title: Day 8: Ngorongoro to Lake Manyara National Park
itinerary.body: Drive to Lake Manyara National Park (2 hours) for a game drive, where you can spot tree-climbing lions, flamingos, and hippos. You can also enjoy an optional cultural tour at Mto wa Mbu village. Overnight at Lake Manyara Serena Lodge or Lake Manyara Kilimamoja Lodge.

itinerary.title: Day 9: Lake Manyara to Amboseli National Park (Kenya)
itinerary.body: After breakfast, drive to Amboseli National Park via the Namanga border. Enjoy an afternoon game drive with stunning views of Mount Kilimanjaro and possible sightings of large elephant herds. Overnight at Amboseli Serena Lodge, Ol Tukai Lodge, or Tortilis Camp.

itinerary.title: Day 10: Full Day in Amboseli
itinerary.body: Start with an early morning game drive against the backdrop of Mount Kilimanjaro, and visit Observation Hill for panoramic views of the park. Enjoy an afternoon game drive for more wildlife encounters. Overnight at Amboseli Serena Lodge, Ol Tukai Lodge, or Tortilis Camp.

itinerary.title: Day 11: Amboseli to Lake Naivasha
itinerary.body: Drive to Lake Naivasha (4-5 hours) and enjoy a boat safari to see hippos and birdlife. You can also visit Crescent Island for a guided walking safari. Overnight at Lake Naivasha Sopa Lodge or Enashipai Resort & Spa.

itinerary.title: Day 12: Lake Naivasha to Nairobi (Departure)
itinerary.body: Spend the morning at leisure or visit Hell’s Gate National Park for a cycling or walking safari. Drive back to Nairobi (2 hours) and transfer to the airport for departure, with an optional stop for shopping at the Karen Blixen Museum or Kazuri Beads Centre.

This is the only park you are asured of seeing the rhinos in black and white and the Rothschild Giraffe.

Amboseli National Park is situated in Loitoktok District, Rift Valley Province of Kenya. Amboseli National Park ecosystem is mainly savannah grassland spread across the Kenya -Tanzania border, an area of low scrubby vegetation and open grassy plains, all of which makes for easy game viewing. It is the best place in Africa to get close to free-ranging elephants, which are for sure a breath-taking sight to behold, whereas various African lions, buffaloes, giraffes, zebras and other species can also be spotted, offering spectacular photographic experiences.

itinerary.title: Day 1: Nairobi – Masai Mara Game Reserve
itinerary.body: Pick up from your hotel at 7:30am, and head for Masai Mara Game Reserve. Just a few kilometers from Nairobi you’ll be able to have a view of the great rift valley, where you will have a breathtaking view of the floor of the rift valley. Later continue driving through Longonot and Suswa and on to the Western walls before arriving in time for lunch. After lunch and relaxation proceed for an afternoon game drive in the reserve where you will be on the look for the big five; Elephants, Lions, Buffalo, Leopards and Rhino. Dinner and Overnight at the Mara Sopa Lodge or a similar lodge.

itinerary.title: Day 2: Full Day Masai Mara Game Reserve
itinerary.body: Early morning game drive and return to camp for breakfast. After breakfast Full day in the park with packed lunch in search of its popular residents, The Masai Mara plains are full of wildebeest during migration season early July to end of September, zebra, impala, topi, giraffe, Thomson’s gazelle are regularly seen, leopards, lions, hyenas, cheetah, jackal and bat-eared foxes. Black rhino are a little shy and hard to spot but are often seen at a distance if you are lucky. Hippos are abundant in the Mara River as are very large Nile crocodiles, who lay in wait for a meal as the wildebeest cross on their annual quest to find new pastures. later Meals and overnight at Sarova Mara game camp or Ashnil Mara camp or Mara Crossing Camp.

itinerary.title: Day 3: Masai Mara Game Reserve – Lake Nakuru National Park
itinerary.body: You will have an early morning game drive, return to the lodge for breakfast before checking out and departing for Lake Nakuru National Park which is located in the Great Rift Valley, arriving in time for lunch. After lunch go for an exciting game drive until 6.30 in the evening. The bird life here is world renown and over 400 birds’s species exist here, White Pelicans, Plovers, Egrets and Marabou Stork. It is also one of the very few places in Africa to see the White and Black Rhino and rare Rothschild Giraffe. Dinner and overnight at Flamingo Hill Camp or a similar camp.

itinerary.title: Day 4: Lake Nakuru National Park – Amboseli National Park
itinerary.body: Early morning breakfast. After breakfast leave Lake Nakuru National Park for Amboseli National Park. You will arrive in time for lunch.Check in at OlTukai lodge have lunch and a short rest. Afternoon game drive in search of its popular residents like the well known predators and their opponents like the Zebra, Wildebeest, Giraffe, Hippo with a view of Mt Kilimanjaro. Later Dinner and overnight at OlTukai lodge or a similar logde.

itinerary.title: Day 5: Full Day Amboseli National Park
itinerary.body: Early morning game drive later return back to lodge for breakfast. After breakfast Full day spend in the park with packed lunch in search of its popular residents like the well known predators and their opponents like the Zebra, Wildebeest, Giraffe, Hippo with a view of Mt Kilimanjaro .Later return to your camp for dinner and overnight at OlTukai lodge or a similar lodge.

itinerary.title: Day 6: Amboseli National Park – Tarangire National Park
itinerary.body: Early morning game viewing before returning to the camp for a full breakfast. Later check out and proceed to Namanga border, where you will be met by your Tanzania guide who will drive you to Tarangire National Park. We arrive at Tarangire safari lodge or Nimali tarangire camp or a similar camp / lodge. in time for lunch. Later, we head into the park for game viewing. Dinner and Overnight at the Camp / Lodge.

itinerary.title: Day 7: Tarangire National Park – Serengeti National Park
itinerary.body: After our breakfast, we head to Serengeti via the Ol Duvai Gorge Museum, where the early man appeared, a million years ago Upon arrival, we will head to the Serengeti National Park, which is widely known for the greatest wildlife spectacle, the great migration of wildebeest. The Plains are also home to resident population of elephants, cheetahs, lions, giraffes and birds. Dinner and overnight shall be at the temporary fixed tents in Seronera Campsite/Similar.

itinerary.title: Day 8: Full Day Serengeti National Park
itinerary.body: Morning and afternoon game drive in the Serengeti with a lunch and leisure break at the lodge or campsite in the mid afternoon .The term ‘serengeti’ means endless plains in maasai language. In the central plains there are carnivores like, leopards, hyena and cheetah. This park is normally the scene of the annual migration of the wildebeest and zebras, which occurs between Serengeti and kenya’s maasai mara game reserve. Eagles, Flamingos, duck, geese, vultures are among the birds that can be seen in the park, dinner and overnight at Serengeti Serena Safari Lodge or Serengeti Tortilis Camp or a similar lodge / camp.

itinerary.title: Day 9: Serengeti National Park – Ngorongoro Crater
itinerary.body: After breakfast, Drive to Ngorongoro Crater for game drives. This is the best place in Tanzania to see black rhino as well as prides of lion that include the magnificent black-manned males. There are lots of colorful flamingos and a variety of water birds. Other game that you can see includes leopard, cheetah, hyena, other members of the antelope family, and small mammals. In the late afternoon. Drive to SIMBA Campsite or Neptune Ngorongoro Luxury Lodge, or a similar lodge / camp for overnight.

itinerary.title: Day 10: Full Day Ngorongoro Crater
itinerary.body: Morning hike in the Southern Ngorongoro Conservation Area to the elephant cave and waterfall. In the afternoon visiting the Iraqw tribe cultural centre in Karatu to learn how the tribe protected their cattle from Masai incursions using underground settlements. After full day activities overnight at SIMBA Campsite or Campsite near Karatu or a similar lodge.

itinerary.title: Day 11: Ngorongoro Crater – Lake Manyara National park
itinerary.body: Early morning game drive later return to your lodge for Breakfast. We arrive at our Lake Manyara camp in time for lunch. Later, we head into the park for game viewing. This soda ash lake consists of huge flocks of pink flamingos, giving a breathtaking scenery. The park is also famously known for its tree-climbing lions, big number of elephants, giraffes, zebras, waterbucks, warthogs, baboons and the lesser known wildlife like the dik-diks, and the klipspringer. Dinner and overnight will be in basic tents at the Panorama Campsite or Similar.

itinerary.title: Day 12: Lake Manyara National park– Arusha
itinerary.body: Early morning game drive later return to your lodge for Breakfast. After breakfast check out in the late afternoon and drive to Kilimanjaro with a short game drive en-route off Lake Manyara National park and drive to Arusha, drop off at your respective hotel or Airport.

tours.title: 14 Days Kenya & Tanzania Combined Wildlife Safari
tours.excerpt: The 14-day Kenya & Tanzania Wildlife Safari Tour is an unforgettable adventure through East Africa’s most iconic wildlife destinations. This well-curated itinerary takes you across the diverse landscapes of Kenya and Tan
overview: The 14-day Kenya & Tanzania Wildlife Safari Tour is an unforgettable adventure through East Africa’s most iconic wildlife destinations. This well-curated itinerary takes you across the diverse landscapes of Kenya and Tanzania, offering breathtaking wildlife experiences in some of the most renowned national parks and game reserves. From the vast plains of Masai Mara and Serengeti to the picturesque Ngorongoro Crater and the elephant-rich Amboseli, this safari promises an extraordinary blend of adventure, culture, and natural beauty.

Starting in Nairobi, Kenya’s bustling capital, the journey kicks off with a visit to the world-famous Masai Mara National Reserve. Here, travelers have the chance to witness the Big Five and, if traveling between July and October, the Great Migration – a spectacular movement of millions of wildebeest and zebras across the Mara River. The itinerary then takes you to Lake Nakuru, known for its vibrant flamingo populations and rhino sanctuary, before continuing to Amboseli National Park, where you will enjoy panoramic views of Mount Kilimanjaro and up-close encounters with large elephant herds.

Crossing into Tanzania, the adventure continues in Tarangire National Park, home to vast elephant populations and scenic baobab trees. The safari then moves on to the Serengeti National Park, famous for its expansive savannahs, abundant predators, and the annual wildebeest migration. Guests can also opt for a breathtaking hot air balloon safari over the Serengeti plains for an unparalleled aerial view of the wildlife below.

itinerary.title: Day 1: Arrival in Nairobi, Kenya
itinerary.body: Arrive at Jomo Kenyatta International Airport (NBO) and meet a safari representative. Transfer to your hotel for relaxation. Optionally, visit the Giraffe Center or Karen Blixen Museum. Overnight in Nairobi.

itinerary.title: Day 2: Nairobi – Masai Mara National Reserve
itinerary.body: After breakfast at the hotel, drive or fly to Masai Mara, which takes approximately 5-6 hours by road. In the afternoon, embark on a game drive in Masai Mara, spotting the Big Five: lion, elephant, buffalo, leopard, and rhino. Overnight at a luxury lodge or camp in Masai Mara.

itinerary.title: Day 3: Full-Day Game Drive in Masai Mara
itinerary.body: Start the day with an early morning game drive to witness predators in action. Visit the Mara River, which is famous for the Great Migration from July to October. Optionally, visit a Maasai village to experience their rich culture. Conclude the day with a sunset game drive before returning to the lodge for an overnight stay.

itinerary.title: Day 4: Masai Mara – Lake Nakuru National Park
itinerary.body: After breakfast, depart for Lake Nakuru, which is a 4-5 hour drive away. In the afternoon, explore Lake Nakuru National Park, known for its rhinos, flamingos, and diverse bird species. Overnight at a lodge in Lake Nakuru.

itinerary.title: Day 5: Lake Nakuru – Amboseli National Park
itinerary.body: After morning breakfast, embark on a scenic 6-7 hour drive to Amboseli National Park. In the afternoon, enjoy a game drive with stunning views of Mount Kilimanjaro. Spot large elephant herds, lions, cheetahs, and giraffes. Overnight at a lodge in Amboseli.

itinerary.title: Day 6: Full-Day Game Drive in Amboseli
itinerary.body: Start with an early morning game drive to witness a breathtaking sunrise over Mount Kilimanjaro. Explore Amboseli’s wetlands, savannah, and acacia forests. Spend the afternoon on another game drive before heading back to the lodge for the night.

itinerary.title: Day 7: Amboseli – Arusha, Tanzania
itinerary.body: njoy breakfast before driving to the Kenya-Tanzania border at Namanga. Cross into Tanzania and continue to Arusha, which takes about 3-4 hours. Spend the rest of the day relaxing at a hotel in Arusha or exploring the city. Overnight in Arusha.

itinerary.title: Day 8: Arusha – Tarangire National Park
itinerary.body: Drive for 2-3 hours to Tarangire National Park. Enjoy a game drive in Tarangire, which is famous for its large elephant herds and scenic landscapes. Visit the Tarangire River for incredible wildlife sightings before retiring for the night at a lodge in Tarangire.

itinerary.title: Day 9: Tarangire – Serengeti National Park
itinerary.body: After breakfast, embark on a scenic 4-5 hour drive to Serengeti National Park. In the afternoon, enjoy a game drive in Serengeti’s vast plains, where you can spot lions, cheetahs, wildebeest, and zebras. Overnight at a lodge in Serengeti.

itinerary.title: Day 10: Full-Day Game Drive in Serengeti
itinerary.body: Start the day with an early morning game drive to see big cats in action. Explore central Serengeti, also known as Seronera, which is renowned for predator sightings. Optionally, take a hot air balloon safari over the Serengeti for a breathtaking aerial view of the wildlife. Overnight at a lodge in Serengeti.

itinerary.title: Day 11: Serengeti – Ngorongoro Conservation Area
itinerary.body: Enjoy a morning game drive in Serengeti before transferring to the Ngorongoro Conservation Area, a 3-4 hour journey. Overnight at a lodge near Ngorongoro.

itinerary.title: Day 12: Ngorongoro Crater Safari
itinerary.body: Descend into the Ngorongoro Crater for a full-day safari experience. Spot black rhinos, lions, elephants, and flamingos at Lake Magadi. Enjoy a picnic lunch inside the crater before heading back to the lodge for an overnight stay.

itinerary.title: Day 13: Ngorongoro – Lake Manyara National Park
itinerary.body: Drive for about 2-3 hours to Lake Manyara National Park. Explore the park on a game drive, which is famous for its tree-climbing lions and hippos. Overnight at a lodge near Lake Manyara.

itinerary.title: Day 14: Lake Manyara – Arusha – Departure
itinerary.body: Start the day with a morning game drive or opt for additional activities such as canoeing or a village visit. Drive back to Arusha, which takes approximately 2-3 hours. Transfer to Kilimanjaro International Airport (JRO) for departure.

tours.title: 15 Days Best of Kenya & Tanzania Combined Wildlife Safari
tours.excerpt: This 15-day safari adventure takes you through the heart of East Africa, immersing you in the untamed beauty of Kenya and Tanzania’s most iconic wildlife destinations. This unforgettable journey showcases the best of the
overview: This 15-day safari adventure takes you through the heart of East Africa, immersing you in the untamed beauty of Kenya and Tanzania’s most iconic wildlife destinations. This unforgettable journey showcases the best of the Maasai Mara, Serengeti, and Ngorongoro Crater, where you will witness some of the most extraordinary wildlife spectacles on Earth. The adventure takes you across vast savannahs, picturesque Rift Valley lakes, and ancient landscapes where nature thrives in its most pristine form.

The safari begins in Nairobi, Kenya’s bustling capital, where you have the opportunity to visit local wildlife conservation projects before venturing into the wilderness. From Nairobi, travel south to Amboseli National Park, a land dominated by the towering presence of Mount Kilimanjaro. Here, you will find large elephant herds roaming freely, alongside lions, cheetahs, giraffes, and a variety of other wildlife. The breathtaking scenery of Amboseli makes it one of the most picturesque parks in Africa, offering stunning photography opportunities.

Continuing the journey, the route takes you to the enchanting Lake Naivasha, where a boat safari allows for an up-close experience with hippos and an array of bird species. A guided walking safari on Crescent Island provides a rare chance to walk among freely roaming giraffes, zebras, and antelopes. The adventure proceeds to Lake Nakuru National Park, a sanctuary for flamingos and endangered rhinos, where game drives take you through acacia forests and open plains teeming with wildlife.

itinerary.title: Day 1: Arrival in Nairobi, Kenya
itinerary.body: Arrive in Kenya’s capital, Nairobi, where you will be greeted and transferred to your hotel. In the afternoon, visit the Giraffe Centre to get up close with endangered Rothschild giraffes, followed by a visit to the David Sheldrick Elephant Orphanage to learn about elephant conservation efforts. Enjoy a welcome dinner before an overnight stay in Nairobi.

itinerary.title: Day 2: Nairobi to Amboseli National Park
itinerary.body: Depart from Nairobi early in the morning for Amboseli National Park, a scenic drive with views of Mount Kilimanjaro. After checking in at your lodge, embark on an afternoon game drive to see large elephant herds and other wildlife against the stunning mountain backdrop.

itinerary.title: Day 9: Maasai Mara to Serengeti National Park
itinerary.body: Cross the border into Tanzania and continue to Serengeti National Park. Enjoy an afternoon game drive in this legendary wilderness, known for its high predator population and endless golden plains.

itinerary.title: Day 3: Full-Day Game Drive in Amboseli
itinerary.body: Spend the day exploring Amboseli with morning and afternoon game drives. Visit Observation Hill for panoramic views of the park, where hippos, elephants, and flamingos gather in the marshlands.

itinerary.title: Day 4: Amboseli to Lake Naivasha
itinerary.body: After breakfast, depart for Lake Naivasha, arriving in time for lunch. In the afternoon, take a boat safari on the lake to see hippos and diverse bird species, followed by a guided walking safari on Crescent Island.

itinerary.title: Day 5: Lake Naivasha to Lake Nakuru National Park
itinerary.body: Drive to Lake Nakuru National Park, a sanctuary for rhinos and flamingos. Enjoy an afternoon game drive through the acacia woodlands and open plains, spotting leopards, buffalo, and the park’s famous flamingo population.

itinerary.title: Day 6: Lake Nakuru to Maasai Mara
itinerary.body: Travel to the Maasai Mara, Kenya’s most famous game reserve. After settling in at your lodge, embark on an afternoon game drive, encountering lions, cheetahs, and elephants.

itinerary.title: Day 7 & 8: Full Days in Maasai Mara
itinerary.body: Spend two full days exploring the vast savannahs of Maasai Mara. Witness the Great Migration (seasonal) and engage in thrilling game drives. A cultural visit to a Maasai village offers insight into their traditional lifestyle. An optional hot air balloon safari at sunrise provides breathtaking aerial views.

itinerary.title: Day 10 & 11: Full Days in Serengeti
itinerary.body: Start the day with an early morning game drive to see big cats in action. Explore central Serengeti, also known as Seronera, which is renowned for predator sightings. Optionally, take a hot air balloon safari over the Serengeti for a breathtaking aerial view of the wildlife. Overnight at a lodge in Serengeti.

itinerary.title: Day 12: Serengeti to Ngorongoro Crater
itinerary.body: Drive to Ngorongoro Crater and descend into the crater floor for a full-day safari. Spot rhinos, lions, and large herds of wildebeest in this natural amphitheater. Enjoy a picnic lunch by a hippo pool before returning to the lodge.

itinerary.title: Day 13: Ngorongoro to Tarangire National Park
itinerary.body: Depart for Tarangire National Park, known for its massive elephant herds and iconic baobab trees. An afternoon game drive reveals a diverse range of wildlife, including lions, zebras, and over 500 bird species.

itinerary.title: Day 14: Tarangire to Arusha
itinerary.body: Enjoy a final morning game drive before heading to Arusha. Spend the afternoon at leisure, relaxing at your lodge or exploring the town.

itinerary.title: Day 15: Departure from Arusha
itinerary.body: After breakfast, transfer to the airport for your departure flight, bringing an end to this unforgettable safari adventure through Kenya and Tanzania.

overview: Our 4 Days Lake Manyara, Ngorongoro Crater & Serengeti Safari takes you to the most famous game parks in Tanzania. Lake Manyara National Park lies 130 kilometers outside of Arusha town and encompasses Lake Manyara and its surroundings. There are five different vegetation zones including groundwater forest, acacia woodland, open areas of short grass, swamps and the lake’s alkaline flats. The park’s wildlife includes more than 350 species of birds, baboon, warthog, giraffe, hippopotamus, elephant and buffalo. If lucky, catch a glimpse of Manyara’s famous tree-climbing lions. Night game drives are permitted in Lake Manyara. Located beneath the cliffs of the Manyara Escarpment, on the edge of the Rift Valley, Lake Manyara National Park offers varied ecosystems, incredible bird life, and breathtaking views. Known for its elephants and tree-climbing lions, Lake Manyara is also excellent for flamingos and other fascinating birds in and around the soda lake.

The Ngorongoro Crater is the world’s largest intact volcanic caldera. Forming a spectacular bowl of about 265 square kilometres, with sides up to 600 metres deep; it is home to approximately 30,000 animals at any one time. The Crater rim is over 2,200 metres high and experiences its own climate. From this high vantage point it is possible to make out the tiny shapes of animals making their way around the crater floor far below. The crater floor consists of a number of different habitats that include grassland, swamps, forests and Lake Makat (Maasai for ‘salt’) – a central soda lake filled by the Munge River. All these various environments attract wildlife to drink, wallow, graze, hide or climb.

overview: Our 5 Days Amboseli , Lake Naivasha & Masai Mara Safari takes you to three most amazing destinations in Kenya. Other attraction of the park includes opportunities to meet the Maasai people and also offers spectacular views of Mount Kilimanjaro, the highest free-standing mountain in the world.

Lake Naivasha is the largest freshwater lake fringed by lush forests of fever trees and overlooked by the ragged-edged of the volcanic Mt. Longonot on floor of the Great Rift Valley. It is home to about 400 species of birds and wildlife such as Giraffe, hippo and waterbuck, but the main attraction is the bird life, which is best observed on a boat trip on the lake.

Last destination is the Masai Mara Game Reserve which is the most famous for a Kenya safari. It is located southwestern of Kenya. It is home to over 5 million animals which roam its savannahs including lions, cheetahs, leopard, hippos, rhinos, elephants, buffalos, giraffes, crocodiles, reedbucks etc. Masai Mara Game Reserve is also famous for the wildebeest Migration which is one of the “Seven New Wonders of the World.”

Later dinner and overnight at Sopa Lodge Naivasha or a similar lodge.

Dinner and overnight at Ashnil Mara camp or Sarova Mara game Camp.

overview: Our 5 Days Lake Nakuru , Bogoria, Naivasha & Masai Mara Safari takes you to the best safari destinations in Kenya. Lake Nakuru National Park is an alkaline soda lake lying 160 km from Nairobi located in the floor of the Great Rift Valley. The lake is home to the stunning flocks of millions of lesser flamingos and over 400 other species of birds, which literally turn the lake shores in to a magnificent pink stretch. Lake Nakuru is also home to the black and white rhino sanctuary, gazelles, Dik Diks, leopards, buffalo, lions and an array of other wildlife.

Lake Bogoria is a saline, alkaline lake that lies in a volcanic region south of Lake Baringo, a little north of the equator. Lake Bogoria, like Lake Nakuru and Lake Elmenteita in Kenya’s Rift Valley, is home, at times, to one of the world’s largest populations of lesser flamingos. The lake is also famous for its natural geysers and hot springs, which are situated along the bank of the lake and within the lake.

Lake Naivasha is the largest freshwater lake fringed by lush forests of fever trees and overlooked by the ragged-edged of the volcanic Mount Longonot on floor of the Great Rift Valley. The main attraction is the bird life, which is best observed on a boat trip on the lake.

itinerary.body: Pick up from your Nairobi hotel or Airport early in the morning and depart Nairobi for Nakuru A 3 hours drive to main gate, you drive through the Great Rift Valley viewing scenery escarpment en-route. you will arrive with short game-en-rout drive proceeding to your lodge for check inn and have lunch. check in at Sarova lion hill Lodge. later Afternoon game drive across the Pink Lake often referred so due to it’s Great masses of Flamingos but due to climate change only few flamingos can be seen, not forgetting the famous white Rhino and black rhino found in this park. Dinner and overnight at Sarova lion hill Lodge or a similar lodge.

itinerary.title: Day 2: Lake Nakuru – Lake Bogoria – Lake Naivasha
itinerary.body: Early morning breakfast leave lake Nakuru with a short game drive with packed lunch and proceed to Lake Bogoria A 3 hours drive to main gate bogoria. but you will have a stop at the Equator line few metres away from the equator line towards the northern side; the water spins clockwise. Towards the southern; spins anticlockwise just Amazing. later proceed to bogoria which is a shallow soda lake with a beautiful scenery and home of lot of flamingo’s and hot springs the geysers. After lunch drive back to Lake Naivasha A 3 and half hours drive to Naivasha for Dinner and overnight at Lake Naivasha Sopa Lodge or Crater Tented Camp.

itinerary.title: Day 3: Lake Naivasha – Masai Mara Game Reserve
itinerary.body: Early morning breakfast. After breakfast leave Lake Naivasha for Masai Mara A 5 hours drive to main gate you will pass to Narok town which is famous Masai town proceeding to Masai Mara park. You will arrive in time for lunch Check in at Mara or Fig Tree Mara Camp and have lunch. Afternoon game drive through the park in search of the Lion, Cheetah, Elephant, Buffalo and other members of the Big five plus other animals. Dinner and overnight at Ashnil Mara camp or Mara Bush Camp / Base Camp or a similar camp.

itinerary.body: Early morning game drive and return to camp for breakfast. After breakfast Full day in the park with packed lunch in search of its popular residents, The Masai Mara plains are full of wildebeest during migration season early July to end of September, zebra, impala, topi, giraffe, Thomson’s gazelle are regularly seen, leopards, lions, hyenas, cheetah, jackal and bat-eared foxes. Dinner and overnight at the Samburu Sopa Lodge or a similar lodge.

itinerary.title: Day 2: Full Day Samburu National Reserve
itinerary.body: After breakfast, head out for a full day of game viewing drive in this dry semi-arid park with its striking background view of the Mathew’s Range. The surrounding terrain is renowned for rare game, -long necked gerenuk, Grevy’s zebra, reticulated giraffe, and the Beisa Oryx. Leopard is the frequent passer-by. Drive through the gently flowing Uaso Nyiro river which traverses this Park provides evergreen vegetation for the wildlife found in this park. Game drives and bird watching safaris are the ideal way to experience the native wildlife in its natural splendor. Dinner and overnight at the Samburu Sopa Lodge or a similar lodge.

After lunch go for an exciting game drive until 6.30 in the evening. The bird life here is world renown and over 400 birds’s species exist here, White Pelicans, Plovers, Egrets and Marabou Stork. It is also one of the very few places in Africa to see the White and Black Rhino and rare Rothschild Giraffe. Dinner and overnight at Flamingo Hill Camp or a similar camp.

Later dinner and overnight at Sopa Lodge Naivasha or a similar lodge.

tours.title: 6 Days Best of Tanzania Adventure Safari
tours.excerpt: Our 6 Days Best of Tanzania Adventure Safari takes you to the most famous game parks in Tanzania. Lake Manyara National Park lies 130 kilometers outside of Arusha town and encompasses Lake Manyara and its surroundings. T
overview: Our 6 Days Best of Tanzania Adventure Safari takes you to the most famous game parks in Tanzania. Lake Manyara National Park lies 130 kilometers outside of Arusha town and encompasses Lake Manyara and its surroundings. There are five different vegetation zones including groundwater forest, acacia woodland, open areas of short grass, swamps and the lake’s alkaline flats. The park’s wildlife includes more than 350 species of birds, baboon, warthog, giraffe, hippopotamus, elephant and buffalo. If lucky, catch a glimpse of Manyara’s famous tree-climbing lions. Night game drives are permitted in Lake Manyara. Located beneath the cliffs of the Manyara Escarpment, on the edge of the Rift Valley, Lake Manyara National Park offers varied ecosystems, incredible bird life, and breathtaking views. Known for its elephants and tree-climbing lions, Lake Manyara is also excellent for flamingos and other fascinating birds in and around the soda lake.

The Ngorongoro Crater is the world’s largest intact volcanic caldera. Forming a spectacular bowl of about 265 square kilometres, with sides up to 600 metres deep; it is home to approximately 30,000 animals at any one time. The Crater rim is over 2,200 metres high and experiences its own climate. From this high vantage point it is possible to make out the tiny shapes of animals making their way around the crater floor far below. The crater floor consists of a number of different habitats that include grassland, swamps, forests and Lake Makat (Maasai for ‘salt’) – a central soda lake filled by the Munge River. All these various environments attract wildlife to drink, wallow, graze, hide or climb.

The Serengeti National Park is home to the greatest wildlife spectacle on earth – the great migration of wildebeest and zebra. The resident population of lion, cheetah, elephant, giraffe, and birds is also impressive. There’s a wide variety of accommodation available, from luxury lodges to mobile camps. The park covers 5,700 sq miles, (14,763 sq km), it’s larger than Connecticut, with at most a couple hundred vehicles driving around. It’s classic savannah, dotted with acacias and filled with wildlife. The western corridor is marked by the Grumeti River, and has more forests and dense bush. The north, Lobo area, meets up with Kenya’s Masai Mara Reserve, is the least visited section.

itinerary.title: Day 1: Arusha – Lake Manyara National Park
itinerary.body: Early morning pick up from your hotel in Arusha at 8:00am for a drive to Lake Manyara National Park takes about 4 hours. After having a picnic lunch in Manyara, you start a late afternoon game drive, which is the best time to view animals in this park. When you approach it from the east, the Rift Valley escarpment looms on the horizon forming an impressive backdrop to the lake. In the tall trees of the ground water forest, monkeys leap from branch to branch, and on the escarpment, elephants stand in the shade. Other animals frequently seen are zebras, impalas, monkeys, giraffes, buffalos, hippos, and others. Overnight at the Lake Manyara Serena Safari Lodge or the twiga lodge and campsite or a similar lodge or camp.

itinerary.title: Day 2: Lake Manyara National Park – Ngorongoro Crater
itinerary.body: After breakfast leave lake manyara for Ngorongoro crater arriving with game drive at the crater rim thereafter you continue to descend 2000 ft (670m) into the crater floor for full afternoon crater tour to see black manned lions, rhinos, buffaloes, elephants and other grazing animals abound with picnic lunch served inside the park. Return to SIMBA Campsite or Neptune Ngorongoro Luxury Lodge for dinner and overnight or a similar camp / lodge.

itinerary.title: Day 3: Ngorongoro Crater – Serengeti National Park
itinerary.body: After breakfast, Leave ngorongoro after breakfast for Serengeti arriving in time for lunch after lunch proceed for afternoon game drive in this unique park to see the many animals. Take your leisure while exploring this world heritage site, where earths largest concentration of plain game still roams free! In the late evening, overnight at the Serengeti Seronera Wildlife Camp or Four Seasons Serengeti Lodge or a similar lodge.

itinerary.title: Day 4: Full Day Serengeti National Park
itinerary.body: Morning and afternoon game drive in the Serengeti with a lunch and leisure break at the lodge or campsite in the mid afternoon .The term ‘serengeti’ means endless plains in maasai language. In the central plains there are carnivores like, leopards, hyena and cheetah. This park is normally the scene of the annual migration of the wildebeest and zebras, which occurs between Serengeti and kenya’s maasai mara game reserve. Eagles, Flamingos, duck, geese, vultures are among the birds that can be seen in the park, dinner and overnight at Serengeti Serena Safari Lodge or Serengeti Tortilis Camp or a similar camp / lodge.

itinerary.title: Day 5: Serengeti National Park – Tarangire National Park
itinerary.body: After breakfast depart for Tarangire National park, Tanzania’s third largest national park and sanctuary for an unusually large elephant population. Majestic baobab trees are an interesting feature of the park, dwarfing the animals that feed beneath them. Animals concentrate along the Tarangire River, which provides the only permanent water supply in the area. There is a great diversity of wildlife including lion, leopard, cheetah and up to six thousand elephant. Arrive in time for lunch after lunch, afternoon spent game viewing in the park, dinner and overnight at the Tarangire safari lodge or Nimali tarangire camp or a similar camp / lodge.

itinerary.title: Day 6: Tarangire National Park – Arusha
itinerary.body: Early morning game drive later return to your lodge for Breakfast. After breakfast check out with a short game drive en-route off Tarangire National Park and drive to Arusha, drop off at your respective hotel or Airport.

Lunch at Samburu Sopa Lodge/Similar Lodge. Afternoon game drives. Samburu Game Reserve is home to some of the rare wildlife species including the Beisa oryx, Reticule Giraffes, Masai Ostrich and the Gravy’s zebras. Dinner and overnight at Samburu Sopa Lodge or a similar lodge.

Drive through the gently flowing Uaso Nyiro river which traverses this Park provides evergreen vegetation for the wildlife found in this park. Game drives and bird watching safaris are the ideal way to experience the native wildlife in its natural splendor. Dinner and overnight at the Samburu Sopa Lodge or a similar lodge.

Amboseli National Park ecosystem is mainly savannah grassland spread across the Kenya -Tanzania border, an area of low scrubby vegetation and open grassy plains, all of which makes for easy game viewing. tours.excerpt: This best of 7day safari in Kenya offers an unforgettable experience, immersing you in diverse landscapes, wildlife, and culture. Your adventure begins in Nairobi, where you’ll be greeted by your guide and can explore lo
overview: This best of 7day safari in Kenya offers an unforgettable experience, immersing you in diverse landscapes, wildlife, and culture. Your adventure begins in Nairobi, where you’ll be greeted by your guide and can explore local attractions such as the Giraffe Centre and the David Sheldrick Elephant Orphanage. You will be able to travel to Amboseli National Park, known for its large elephant herds and views of Mount Kilimanjaro. Enjoy a game drive spotting wildlife like elephants, lions, and cheetahs. You will have an early morning game drive, cultural visits, and an afternoon exploration of Amboseli’s wetlands.

You will be able to visit Lake Naivasha, a serene freshwater lake in the Great Rift Valley. Enjoy a boat ride to spot hippos and birds, or opt for a walking safari on Crescent Island. You will be taken to the Masai Mara, a world-renowned reserve. After a thrilling game drive, spot the Big Five: lions, leopards, rhinos, elephants, and buffalo. Explore the Mara with additional game drives, and for a unique experience, you can take an optional hot air balloon ride over the plains. You may also witness the Great Migration, depending on the season.

On your final day, enjoy a last game drive before returning to Nairobi, where you can visit the Karen Blixen Museum or shop for souvenirs. Your adventure ends with a transfer to the airport. Highlights of the safari include guided game drives, a boat ride on Lake Naivasha, cultural experiences with the Maasai, and diverse landscapes from Mount Kilimanjaro to the Mara plains. Essential items to bring include comfortable clothing, sturdy shoes, binoculars, sunscreen, and insect repellent. This safari offers the adventure of a lifetime, showcasing Kenya’s stunning wilderness.

itinerary.body: Upon arrival at Jomo Kenyatta International Airport in Nairobi, you will be warmly greeted by your guide. You’ll then transfer to your hotel or lodge to relax and unwind after your journey. If time allows, you can explore some of Nairobi’s iconic attractions, such as the Giraffe Centre or the David Sheldrick Elephant Orphanage. In the evening, enjoy a delightful dinner at your lodge or a local restaurant before settling in for an overnight stay in Nairobi.

itinerary.title: Day 2: Nairobi to Amboseli National Park

Upon arrival, enjoy lunch at your lodge before heading out on your first game drive. Immerse yourself in the park’s stunning scenery and spot wildlife such as elephants, lions, cheetahs, and a variety of bird species, all set against the majestic backdrop of Africa’s tallest mountain. Your day includes breakfast, lunch, and dinner, with an overnight stay at a lodge or camp in Amboseli.

itinerary.title: Day 3: Full Day in Amboseli

Spend the daytime relaxing at the lodge or opt for an enriching cultural visit to a Maasai village. In the afternoon, venture out for another game drive, exploring Amboseli’s picturesque wetlands and diverse wildlife. Enjoy breakfast, lunch, and dinner provided during your stay, and end your day with an overnight stay at a lodge or camp in the heart of Amboseli.

itinerary.title: Day 4: Amboseli to Lake Naivasha

Depart in the morning and arrive in time for lunch, followed by a relaxing boat ride on the lake to spot hippos and a variety of bird species. For those seeking more adventure, an optional guided walking safari on Crescent Island offers up-close encounters with giraffes, zebras, and antelope. Meals for the day include breakfast, lunch, and dinner, with an overnight stay at a lodge or camp near the lake.

Meals provided include breakfast, lunch, and dinner, and you’ll spend the night immersed in nature at a lodge or camp in the Masai Mara.

tours.title: 7 Days Lake Manyara, Serengeti, Ngorongoro & Tarangire Safari
tours.excerpt: Our 7 Days Lake Manyara, Serengeti, Ngorongoro & Tarangire Safari takes you to the most famous game parks in Tanzania. Lake Manyara National Park lies 130 kilometers outside of Arusha town and encompasses Lake Manyara an
overview: Our 7 Days Lake Manyara, Serengeti, Ngorongoro & Tarangire Safari takes you to the most famous game parks in Tanzania. Lake Manyara National Park lies 130 kilometers outside of Arusha town and encompasses Lake Manyara and its surroundings. There are five different vegetation zones including groundwater forest, acacia woodland, open areas of short grass, swamps and the lake’s alkaline flats. The park’s wildlife includes more than 350 species of birds, baboon, warthog, giraffe, hippopotamus, elephant and buffalo. If lucky, catch a glimpse of Manyara’s famous tree-climbing lions. Night game drives are permitted in Lake Manyara. Located beneath the cliffs of the Manyara Escarpment, on the edge of the Rift Valley, Lake Manyara National Park offers varied ecosystems, incredible bird life, and breathtaking views. Known for its elephants and tree-climbing lions, Lake Manyara is also excellent for flamingos and other fascinating birds in and around the soda lake.

The Serengeti National Park is home to the greatest wildlife spectacle on earth – the great migration of wildebeest and zebra. The resident population of lion, cheetah, elephant, giraffe, and birds is also impressive. There’s a wide variety of accommodation available, from luxury lodges to mobile camps. The park covers 5,700 sq miles, (14,763 sq km), it’s larger than Connecticut, with at most a couple hundred vehicles driving around. It’s classic savannah, dotted with acacias and filled with wildlife. The western corridor is marked by the Grumeti River, and has more forests and dense bush. The north, Lobo area, meets up with Kenya’s Masai Mara Reserve, is the least visited section.

The Ngorongoro Crater is the world’s largest intact volcanic caldera. Forming a spectacular bowl of about 265 square kilometres, with sides up to 600 metres deep; it is home to approximately 30,000 animals at any one time. The Crater rim is over 2,200 metres high and experiences its own climate. From this high vantage point it is possible to make out the tiny shapes of animals making their way around the crater floor far below. The crater floor consists of a number of different habitats that include grassland, swamps, forests and Lake Makat (Maasai for ‘salt’) – a central soda lake filled by the Munge River. All these various environments attract wildlife to drink, wallow, graze, hide or climb.

itinerary.title: Day 1: Arusha– Lake Manyara National Park
itinerary.body: Early morning pick up from your hotel in Arusha at 8:00am for a drive to lake Manyara National Park takes about 4 hours. After having a picnic lunch in Manyara, you start a late afternoon game drive, which is the best time to view animals in this park. When you approach it from the east, the Rift Valley escarpment looms on the horizon forming an impressive backdrop to the lake. In the tall trees of the ground water forest, monkeys leap from branch to branch, and on the escarpment, elephants stand in the shade. Other animals frequently seen are zebras, impalas, monkeys, giraffes, buffalos, hippos, and others. Overnight at the Lake Manyara Serena Safari Lodge or the twiga lodge and campsite. or a similar lodge or camp.

itinerary.title: Day 2: Lake Manyara National Park – Serengeti National Park
itinerary.body: The drive to Serengeti National Park via Oldupai Gorge takes 3 to 4 hours. Olduvai Gorge is an archaeological site located in the eastern Serengeti plains, in which early human fossils were first discovered. It has an amazing landscape that resulted from the same tectonic forces that created the Great Rift Valley millions of years ago. Then, in the late evening drive to and overnight at the Serengeti Seronera Wildlife Camp or Four Seasons Serengeti Lodge or a similar camp.

itinerary.title: Day 3: Full Day Serengeti National Park
itinerary.body: Morning and afternoon game drive in the Serengeti with a lunch and leisure break at the lodge or campsite in the mid afternoon .The term ‘serengeti’ means endless plains in maasai language. In the central plains there are carnivores like, leopards, hyena and cheetah. This park is normally the scene of the annual migration of the wildebeest and zebras, which occurs between Serengeti and kenya’s maasai mara game reserve. Eagles, Flamingos, duck, geese, vultures are among the birds that can be seen in the park, dinner and overnight at Serengeti Serena Safari Lodge or Serengeti Tortilis Camp or a similar lodge / camp.

itinerary.title: Day 4: Serengeti National Park – Ngorongoro Crater
itinerary.body: After breakfast, Drive to Ngorongoro Crater for game drives. This is the best place in Tanzania to see black rhino as well as prides of lion that include the magnificent black-manned males. There are lots of colorful flamingos and a variety of water birds. Other game that you can see includes leopard, cheetah, hyena, other members of the antelope family, and small mammals. In the late afternoon. Drive to SIMBA Campsite or Neptune Ngorongoro Luxury Lodge, or a similar lodge / camp for overnight.

itinerary.title: Day 5: Full Day Ngorongoro Crater
itinerary.body: Morning hike in the Southern Ngorongoro Conservation Area to the elephant cave and waterfall. In the afternoon visiting the Iraqw tribe cultural centre in Karatu to learn how the tribe protected their cattle from Masai incursions using underground settlements. After full day activities overnight at SIMBA Campsite or Campsite near Karatu or a similar camp.

itinerary.title: Day 6: Ngorongoro Crater – Tarangire National Park
itinerary.body: After breakfast depart for Tarangire National park, Tanzania’s third largest national park and sanctuary for an unusually large elephant population. Majestic baobab trees are an interesting feature of the park, dwarfing the animals that feed beneath them. Animals concentrate along the Tarangire River, which provides the only permanent water supply in the area. There is a great diversity of wildlife including lion, leopard, cheetah and up to six thousand elephant. Arrive in time for lunch after lunch, afternoon spent game viewing in the park, dinner and overnight at the Tarangire safari lodge or Nimali tarangire camp or a similar camp / lodge.

itinerary.body: Early morning game drive later return to your lodge for Breakfast. After breakfast check out with a short game drive en-route off Tarangire National Park and drive to Arusha, drop off at your respective hotel or Airport.

overview: Our 7 Days Tsavo West, Tsavo East, Amboseli, Lake Naivasha & Masai Mara Safari takes you to the most famous game reserves and National parks in Africa. Tsavo West National Park is located in the Coast Province of Kenya. The park covers an area of 9,065 square kilometres. It ranges from 200-1000 metres in altitude. This park is marked with a number of rocky outcrops and volcanic hills. It’s lesser known due to its large size and a smaller concentration of wildlife compared with other parks.

Tsavo East National Park is one of the oldest parks in Kenya, located South East of Kenya near the Town of Voi in the Taita-Taveta District of Coast Province, inland from the Coast, it is 13,747 sq.km. offers great wildlife viewing in pristine wilderness. All of the Big Five are here. Elephants are common, and their red dust coating makes them stand out against the arid environment. Of the big cats, lions are most easily spotted. Buffalo, zebra and plenty of Masai giraffes are some of the other animals you can expect to see.

Amboseli National Park is one of Kenya’s most popular parks in Kenya, located Loitoktok District, Rift Valley. The park is famous for being the best place in Africa to get close to free-ranging elephants among other wildlife species. Other attraction of the park includes opportunities to meet the Maasai people and also offers spectacular views of Mount Kilimanjaro, the highest free-standing mountain in the world.

tours.title: 8 Days Lake Manyara, Ngorongoro & Serengeti Wildebeest Migration Safari
tours.excerpt: Our 8 Days Lake Manyara,Serengeti & Ngorongoro Safari takes you to the most famous game parks in Tanzania. Lake Manyara National Park lies 130 kilometers outside of Arusha town and encompasses Lake Manyara and its surrou
overview: Our 8 Days Lake Manyara,Serengeti & Ngorongoro Safari takes you to the most famous game parks in Tanzania. Lake Manyara National Park lies 130 kilometers outside of Arusha town and encompasses Lake Manyara and its surroundings. There are five different vegetation zones including groundwater forest, acacia woodland, open areas of short grass, swamps and the lake’s alkaline flats. The park’s wildlife includes more than 350 species of birds, baboon, warthog, giraffe, hippopotamus, elephant and buffalo. If lucky, catch a glimpse of Manyara’s famous tree-climbing lions. Night game drives are permitted in Lake Manyara. Located beneath the cliffs of the Manyara Escarpment, on the edge of the Rift Valley, Lake Manyara National Park offers varied ecosystems, incredible bird life, and breathtaking views. Known for its elephants and tree-climbing lions, Lake Manyara is also excellent for flamingos and other fascinating birds in and around the soda lake.

The Serengeti National Park is home to the greatest wildlife spectacle on earth – the great migration of wildebeest and zebra. The resident population of lion, cheetah, elephant, giraffe, and birds is also impressive. There’s a wide variety of accommodation available, from luxury lodges to mobile camps. The park covers 5,700 sq miles, (14,763 sq km), it’s larger than Connecticut, with at most a couple hundred vehicles driving around. It’s classic savannah, dotted with acacias and filled with wildlife. The western corridor is marked by the Grumeti River, and has more forests and dense bush. The north, Lobo area, meets up with Kenya’s Masai Mara Reserve, is the least visited section.

The Ngorongoro Crater is the world’s largest intact volcanic caldera. Forming a spectacular bowl of about 265 square kilometres, with sides up to 600 metres deep; it is home to approximately 30,000 animals at any one time. The Crater rim is over 2,200 metres high and experiences its own climate. From this high vantage point it is possible to make out the tiny shapes of animals making their way around the crater floor far below. The crater floor consists of a number of different habitats that include grassland, swamps, forests and Lake Makat (Maasai for ‘salt’) – a central soda lake filled by the Munge River. All these various environments attract wildlife to drink, wallow, graze, hide or climb.

itinerary.title: Day 1: Arusha – Lake Manyara National Park
itinerary.body: Early morning pick up from your hotel in Arusha at 8:00am for a drive to Lake Manyara National Park takes about 4 hours. After having a picnic lunch in Manyara, you start a late afternoon game drive, which is the best time to view animals in this park. When you approach it from the east, the Rift Valley escarpment looms on the horizon forming an impressive backdrop to the lake. In the tall trees of the ground water forest, monkeys leap from branch to branch, and on the escarpment, elephants stand in the shade. Other animals frequently seen are zebras, impalas, monkeys, giraffes, buffalos, hippos, and others. Overnight at the Lake Manyara Serena Safari Lodge or the twiga lodge and campsite or a similar lodge or camp.

itinerary.title: Day 2: Lake Manyara National Park – Serengeti National Park
itinerary.body: The drive to Serengeti National Park via Oldupai Gorge takes 3 to 4 hours. Olduvai Gorge is an archaeological site located in the eastern Serengeti plains, in which early human fossils were first discovered. It has an amazing landscape that resulted from the same tectonic forces that created the Great Rift Valley millions of years ago. Then, in the late evening drive to and overnight at the Serengeti Seronera Wildlife Camp or Four Seasons Serengeti Lodge or a similar camp.

itinerary.title: Day 3 & 4: Full Day Serengeti National Park
itinerary.body: Morning and afternoon game drive in the Serengeti with a lunch and leisure break at the lodge or campsite in the mid afternoon .The term ‘serengeti’ means endless plains in maasai language. In the central plains there are carnivores like, leopards, hyena and cheetah. This park is normally the scene of the annual migration of the wildebeest and zebras, which occurs between Serengeti and kenya’s maasai mara game reserve. Eagles, Flamingos, duck, geese, vultures are among the birds that can be seen in the park, dinner and overnight at Serengeti Serena Safari Lodge or Serengeti Tortilis Camp or a similar camp.

itinerary.title: Day 5: Serengeti National Park – Ngorongoro Crater
itinerary.body: After breakfast, Drive to Ngorongoro Crater for game drives. This is the best place in Tanzania to see black rhino as well as prides of lion that include the magnificent black-manned males. There are lots of colorful flamingos and a variety of water birds. Other game that you can see includes leopard, cheetah, hyena, other members of the antelope family, and small mammals. In the late afternoon. Drive to SIMBA Campsite or Neptune Ngorongoro Luxury Lodge, or a similar camp / lodge for overnight.

itinerary.title: Day 6 & 7: Ngorongoro Crater
itinerary.body: At 7a.m check out of the lodge with packed picnic lunch and depart for a tour to the rim of the crater. Later ascend for a game drive to look for numerous plains game and the big five. Spend the day within the crater and have lunch at one of the famous picnic spots in the park. In the evening you will return to the SIMBA Campsite or Neptune Ngorongoro Luxury Lodge , or a similar camp / lodge for overnight.
